name: Italy
intro: Step into a country of deep historical heritage, unmatched Renaissance art masterworks, and absolute culinary delight. From Rome's ancient arenas to Amalfi's picturesque clifftop villas, Italy is the ultimate European romance.
bestSeason: April to June (Spring sun) & September to October (Golden autumn)
weather: Mediterranean climate. Warm dry summers (24°C to 33°C), cool rainy winters (6°C to 14°C) in the central plains.
visaInfo: Schengen Visa required for Indian passport holders.
flightDuration: Approx 8-10 hours flight from New Delhi or Mumbai.
highlights: Stand inside the historic Colosseum and Roman Forum in Rome
Ride a traditional wood gondola through the quiet canals of Venice
View Michelangelo's David and Botticelli's masterpieces in Florence
Drive a vintage convertible along the dramatic cliff roads of the Amalfi Coast

famousPlaces.name: Ancient Rome
famousPlaces.shortDesc: The eternal city, where 2,000-year-old Roman ruins stand alongside Vatican palaces and Renaissance plazas.
famousPlaces.overview: Rome is a living open-air museum. The capital of a historic empire, its streets are paved with history. Visitors can walk the ruins of the Colosseum, marvel at the Michelangelo frescoes inside the Sistine Chapel, and toss a coin into the Trevi Fountain to secure their return.
famousPlaces.bestTimeToVisit: April to May, September to October

hotels.name: Hotel Hassler Roma
hotels.description: Prestigious five-star hotel set at the top of the Spanish Steps.

hotels.name: Rocco Forte Hotel de Russie
hotels.description: Featuring a secret garden oasis in the heart of Rome near Piazza del Popolo.

famousPlaces.meals: Fresh bakery breakfasts and custom Roman pasta dinners.
famousPlaces.transport: Private sedan airport transfers and high-speed rail passes.
famousPlaces.activities: Colosseum Private Night Tour, Vatican Museums Skip-the-line Tour, Trastevere Food Crawl.
included: Private historian guide for Roman Forum

faqs.q: What is the dress code for Vatican City?
faqs.a: Shoulders and knees must be covered to enter St. Peter's Basilica and the Vatican Museums.

reviews.author: Lucia F.
reviews.text: Standing inside the Colosseum at sunset with a private guide made history come alive.

itinerary.title: Imperial Rome & Trevi Walk
itinerary.morning: Arrive in Rome, transfer to hotel. Rest.
itinerary.afternoon: Walk past Piazza Navona, the Pantheon, and toss a coin into the Trevi Fountain.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy classic Roman dishes like Cacio e Pepe in a cozy Trastevere Osteria.

itinerary.title: Colosseum Arena & Vatican Museums
itinerary.morning: Explore the Colosseum floor and walk the ancient paths of the Roman Forum.
itinerary.afternoon: Guided tour of the Vatican Museums, Raphael Rooms, and Sistine Chapel.
itinerary.evening: Private cooking class making handmade fettuccine with a local chef.

famousPlaces.name: Amalfi Coast
famousPlaces.shortDesc: A dramatic coastline of pastel-colored clifftop towns, lemon orchards, and sparkling turquoise Mediterranean waters.
famousPlaces.overview: The Amalfi Coast is Italy's coastal crown jewel. Vertical cliffs drop into a deep blue sea, with towns like Positano and Amalfi clinging precariously to the rocks. Lemon trees fragrance the air, and historic pathways offer sweeping sea panoramas.

hotels.name: Le Sirenuse Positano
hotels.description: World-famous luxury boutique hotel overlooking Positano bay.

famousPlaces.meals: Fresh seafood dining and local limoncello tastings.
famousPlaces.transport: Private Mercedes driver along the coast roads and private boat charters.
famousPlaces.activities: Private Yacht Cruise to Capri, Ravello Villa Rufolo Gardens Tour, Limoncello Tasting.
included: Private boat charter to Capri island
excluded: Capri Blue Grotto rowing boat fees

faqs.a: The coast road is extremely narrow and winding. We include professional private drivers for your safety and comfort.

reviews.author: Marco B.
reviews.text: Waking up to the sea view in Positano was the dream of a lifetime. The boat cruise to Capri was amazing.

itinerary.title: Coastal Drive & Positano Sunset
itinerary.morning: Pick up by chauffeur in Naples and drive the breathtaking Amalfi Coast road.
itinerary.afternoon: Check into Le Sirenuse and explore the narrow boutique stairways of Positano.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy candlelight dining with views of Positano's illuminated cliffs.

itinerary.title: Capri Yacht Cruise
itinerary.morning: Board your private speed-boat for a full day cruise to the Isle of Capri.
itinerary.afternoon: Swim in hidden coves and anchor to walk the streets of Capri and Anacapri.
itinerary.evening: Return to Positano for fresh seafood pasta at a beachside trattoria.
